criteria_evidence.usability: Intuitive web interface with clear prompting system. Minimal learning curve.
criteria_evidence.generation_speed: Generates 15-second outputs in approximately 45 seconds consistently. Fast iteration.
criteria_evidence.audio_quality: Professional-quality audio with minor compression artifacts at high frequencies.
criteria_evidence.stylistic_accuracy: Successfully captures genre characteristics across diverse styles tested.
criteria_evidence.parameter_control: Limited direct control over musical parameters. Relies on text descriptions.
criteria_evidence.content_generation_control: Generates full mixes rather than individual stems. Difficult to isolate elements.
criteria_evidence.daw_integration: File export only. No plugin or real-time integration available.
criteria_evidence.creative_workflow: Fast generation enables rapid ideation and iteration. Supports creative flow.

strengths: Exceptional generation speed enables rapid iteration
Good stylistic accuracy across multiple genres
High audio quality suitable for professional use
weaknesses: Generates full mixes rather than controllable stems
Parameter control could be more granular
overall_assessment.recommendations: Best suited for rapid ideation, inspiration gathering, and initial concept development. Excellent for composers needing quick musical sketches across diverse genres.
